properties.name: auth-platform.jwt.jwks-uri
properties.description: URI of the JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) endpoint used to fetch the signing keys for JWT verification. Required; auto-configuration fails startup if this is missing.

properties.name: auth-platform.jwt.expected-issuer
properties.description: Expected value of the JWT 'iss' claim; tokens issued by any other issuer are rejected. Required; auto-configuration fails startup if this is missing.

properties.name: auth-platform.jwt.expected-audience
properties.description: Expected value of the JWT 'aud' claim. Optional: when unset or blank, audience is not enforced and tokens are accepted regardless of their 'aud' claim.

properties.name: auth-platform.jwt.min-refresh-interval-seconds
properties.description: Minimum number of seconds to wait between JWKS refresh attempts, to avoid hammering the JWKS endpoint on repeated key-lookup misses.

properties.name: auth-platform.jwt.connect-timeout-millis
properties.description: Connect timeout, in milliseconds, used by the HTTP client when fetching the JWKS document.

properties.name: auth-platform.jwt.read-timeout-millis
properties.description: Read timeout, in milliseconds, used by the HTTP client when fetching the JWKS document.
